topic: Analytics report issues and data calibration
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered multiple technical points regarding analytics reporting. Initially, a discussion occurred about updating calibration methods for cluster and network data, moving towards using facility dictionaries for consistency across clients.

Later, the focus shifted to discrepancies in dwell-time reports. It was noted that Dwell Time (Cluster) and Network metrics were reported for specific locations (e.g., Rustenburg taxi rank), but there were questions about how these values are calculated, especially when only one sensor is involved or if new dwell-time features are not yet released.

A major portion of the discussion involved debugging a report showing Total Traffic (Screens) and Dwell Time metrics even when no calibrated sessions were recorded. The issue was traced to data aggregation logic, specifically where impressions for frames existed in `ml_2` but did not correlate with traffic screen counts or dwell time. It was determined that the relationship between screens/traffic and dwell-time needs review, potentially requiring a redesign of the session merging query.

The discussion concluded by agreeing to postpone further investigation into the data aggregation logic until Monday.
decisions: The calibration method for cluster and network facility numbers will be updated using dictionary lookups for improved consistency.
Further debugging of the Total Traffic/Dwell Time discrepancy in the beta report is postponed until Monday.
action_items: Update calibration logic to use facility dictionaries (estimated time: a couple of hours).
